OBTIME011.name: Canonical freshness clock adapter
OBTIME011.rule: Canonical freshness evaluation consumes the verified OB_MARKET_TIME_V1 observation instant rather than a caller-authored evaluation clock.

OBTIME012.name: Active-unbound Decision Context time
OBTIME012.rule: New Decision Context snapshots no longer describe OBTIME as pending. They explicitly represent active but unbound canonical temporal context.

OBTIME013.name: Verified Decision Context time binding
OBTIME013.rule: A verified market-time receipt may be immutably bound into Decision Context, producing a new context ID and fingerprint.

OBTIME014.name: Historical pending-time compatibility
OBTIME014.rule: Historical hash-bound Decision Context snapshots containing PENDING_OBTIME remain valid historical artifacts and may be upgraded only by producing a new immutable snapshot.

OBTIME015.name: Decision Context temporal integration closure
OBTIME015.rule: decision_context no longer lists temporal_context as deferred; source provenance remains deferred.

regression_transition.graduation_reason: OBTIME011-015 introduces an explicit verified OB_MARKET_TIME_V1 binding path for Decision Context.
regression_transition.prior_obtime010_rule: Active canonical authority may remain deferred for consumers that have not integrated it.
